items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Then there was another session with Jack (the Bear) Parker replacing Best and Al Lucas in place of Robinson on bass.

ctx.x: December 15th, 1944, Mary Lou recorded three numbers for Asch with seven musicians which included Coleman Hawkins, Claude Green, clarinet, Joe Evans, alto sax, Eddie Robinson, bass, Denzil Best on drums and me. Then there was another session with Jack (the Bear) Parker replacing
Best and Al Lucas in place of Robinson on bass.

We had a real fine trio because we rehearsed well and the arrangements that Mary Lou did were in the groove. Meantime, Al Hall was engaged for the radio show of Mildred Bailey and that was the reason he was not on the last Asch sessions.
